payments-panel.title: Payment
payments-panel.label-deadline: Complete payment by {payBy}, or the hold on this order is released.
payments-panel.card-unavailable: Card payment is not available in this shop right now.
payments-panel.button-finish: I have finished at my bank
payments-panel.success: Payment received — the order is paid.
payments-panel.explain-requires_action: Your bank wants to confirm this payment. Finish it in the window your bank opened, then tell us here.
payments-panel.explain-processing: The provider is still settling this payment. It can take a while; we will email you when it lands.
payments-panel.refunded-by-hand: Refunded by hand — the money was returned to the customer outside this application.
payments-panel.refund-pending: Refund pending — the money has not been confirmed back yet. An operator hands it back outside this application, then marks it returned.
payments-panel.refund-card-pending: Refund pending — the payment provider has not confirmed the refund yet. It is retried automatically.
payments-panel.refund-owed-another-way: Refund pending — we could not return it to your card. We have emailed you to agree another way, at no cost to you.

transfer-instructions-panel.title: Bank transfer instructions
transfer-instructions-panel.copy-failed: Could not copy — select the text and copy it by hand.
transfer-instructions-panel.hint-reference: Write this reference in your transfer's description exactly as shown, so we can match your payment to this order.

order-reference-search.hint-reference: Paste the RF code from a bank statement line to find the order it pays.

refund-cancel-form.hint-note: Kept in the audit log, never shown to the customer. Say who refunded it elsewhere, and where.
refund-cancel-form.error-note-too-long: The note is too long ({max} characters at most)

record-offline-payment-form.success: Payment recorded — the order is paid.

payments-list-page.awaiting-hint: Bank transfers still owed, soonest deadline first. Open one to see the payment.
payments-list-page.failure-reason-expired_or_canceled_card: The card has expired or was cancelled
payments-list-page.failure-reason-lost_or_stolen_card: The card was reported lost or stolen
payments-list-page.failure-reason-provider_removed: The payment provider is no longer installed
payments-list-page.failure-reason-unknown: The provider gave no usable reason
payments-list-page.failure-reason-canceled: Canceled by staff: nothing was sent
payments-list-page.failure-reason-disputed: The buyer's bank took the money back in a dispute
payments-list-page.attention-kind-refused_refund: Refused: return the money another way
payments-list-page.attention-kind-reversed_refund: Sent back by the bank: return the money another way
payments-list-page.attention-kind-refund_exceeds_remaining: A refund made elsewhere left no room: cancel it or mark it returned
payments-list-page.attention-kind-manual_refund_owed: Money to hand back outside the system
payments-list-page.attention-deadline-left: Last day to pay this back | {count} day left to pay this back | {count} days left to pay this back
payments-list-page.attention-deadline-over: Pay-back deadline passed {count} day ago | Pay-back deadline passed {count} days ago
payments-list-page.attention-hint: Only problems still recorded on a payment or an order. A fixed one disappears on the next read.
payments-list-page.attention-audit-note: A payment whose amount did not match its order is not listed here: it was cancelled and refunded automatically, and recorded in the audit log as payment.amount_mismatch.
payments-list-page.confirm-mark-returned: Confirm you returned {amount} to the customer outside the app? Nothing is sent.
payments-list-page.confirm-mark-returned-card: Confirm you returned {amount} to the customer another way? Do this only after the money has left: the app stops retrying this refund and tells the customer it is back.
payments-list-page.cancel-refund-done: Refund canceled. Nothing was sent and nobody was notified.
payments-list-page.confirm-refund: Refund everything still refundable on order {order}? The money goes back to the customer.
payments-list-page.attention-kind-dispute_needs_response: Dispute to answer in the provider's dashboard
payments-list-page.attention-dispute-due-left: Last day to send evidence | {count} day left to send evidence | {count} days left to send evidence
payments-list-page.attention-dispute-due-over: Evidence deadline passed {count} day ago | Evidence deadline passed {count} days ago
payments-list-page.attention-already-refunded: Already refunded {amount}: send the refund as evidence

dispute-banner.title-chargeback: Chargeback: the bank took the money back
dispute-banner.status-under_review: Evidence sent, the bank is deciding
dispute-banner.status-lost: Lost: the bank kept the money
dispute-banner.status-accepted: Accepted: the bank kept the money
dispute-banner.due-left: Last day to answer | {count} day left to answer | {count} days left to answer
dispute-banner.due-over: The deadline passed {count} day ago | The deadline passed {count} days ago
dispute-banner.open-dashboard: Answer it in the provider's dashboard
dispute-banner.refunds-paused: Refunds are paused while the chargeback is open: the bank already took this money back, and a refund on top would pay the buyer twice.
dispute-banner.reason-bank_cannot_process: The bank could not process the payment
dispute-banner.reason-credit_not_processed: The buyer says a credit was not processed
dispute-banner.reason-duplicate: The buyer says they were charged twice
dispute-banner.reason-fraudulent: The buyer says they did not make the payment
dispute-banner.reason-insufficient_funds: The buyer's account had insufficient funds
dispute-banner.reason-product_not_received: The buyer says the goods did not arrive
dispute-banner.reason-product_unacceptable: The buyer says the goods were not as described
dispute-banner.reason-subscription_canceled: The buyer says a subscription was canceled
dispute-banner.reason-unrecognized: The buyer does not recognise the charge

refund-notice.recorded: Refund recorded. Hand the money back outside the app, then press Mark returned.
refund-notice.refused: The card provider refused this refund: {reason}. {next}
refund-notice.settle-by-hand: Return the money another way, then press Mark returned.
refund-notice.retried: It stays open and is retried automatically.
refund-notice.cancel-under-way: Order cancelled. The refund is under way; its status shows on the payment.
refund-notice.receive-owed: Goods received. The refund is not settled yet; follow it on the order's payment.
